final: WITH player_awards_joined AS (SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats FROM player_award pa INNER JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id), player_counts AS (SELECT player_id, bats, COUNT(*) as player_count FROM player_awards_joined GROUP BY player_id, bats), hand_totals AS (SELECT bats, SUM(player_count) as hand_total FROM player_counts GROUP BY bats), player_shares AS (SELECT pc.player_id, pc.bats, pc.player_count, CAST(pc.player_count AS FLOAT) / ht.hand_total as player_share FROM player_counts pc INNER JOIN hand_totals ht ON pc.bats = ht.bats), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(player_share) as avg_share FROM player_shares) SELECT ps.player_id, ps.bats, ps.player_count, ps.player_share, ps.player_share - oa.avg_share as share_diff FROM player_shares ps CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oa.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND ps.player_share > oa.avg_share ORDER BY ps.player_share - oa.avg_share DESC, ps.player_share - oa.avg_share IS NULL LIMIT 10
